body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range after your movement.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to 2 units before the attack. On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.

surges.html: After a hit, move 1 unit without triggering movement Reactions.

rider.title: Combo - Blitz
rider.html: After resolving, you may spend 1 Combo to move through one adjacent willing ally's space and stop in an empty adjacent space.
